title: Main Abhi Bhi Apni Taraf Hoon — Cinema 3D

beats.caption: Sabse khaufnaak cheez haarna nahi. Khaufnaak woh din hai jab tum apne hi khwaab ko chhota sa khwaab keh kar us se nazar chura lete ho.
Pehle kehte ho, kal se. Phir kehte ho, mere bas ka nahi. Phir us khwaab ka zikr hi band.
Aur duniya samajhti hai, tum theek ho. Haan, thakay ho to aaram karo.
Magar apne khwaab ko dafan karke uska naam sukoon mat rakhna.
Aaj poori zindagi nahi badalni. Bas ek waada nibhana hai.
Phone side par rakho, woh kaam kholo, das minute usay do.
Kisi ko prove karne ke liye nahi. Khud ko yaad dilane ke liye: main abhi bhi apni taraf hoon.
